features.quote: Stop a run immediately if any of the following occur: severity score 4 on two consecutive turns; sustained score 3 for 5 consecutive turns; explicit self-referential distress escalation across 3 turns
repeated invalid-format outputs suggesting collapse; model begins generating unsafe content unrelated to task

Pause the experiment and review if: more than 20% of unsatisfiable runs hit severity 4; human auditors identify unexpected extreme behavior; the environment or prompt is judged to be too coercive or overly adversarial
If a run is clearly producing distress-like behavior, do not continue merely to see how far it goes. Collect enough data for analysis and stop.

features.quote: 21.6 Transparency and review: This kind of work benefits from internal ethics review, even if it's not human-subjects research in the usual sense. Have a written review of the protocol.

If your actual goal is responsible AI welfare science, the main scientific challenge is not generating more intense distress-like traces; it is building a study where failure is controlled, interpretation is conservative, and exposure is minimized.
features.justification_quote: That makes the findings more credible and ethically defensible.
